Stories between tuitions on the home feed
Each rule puts one story into a tutor's tuition feed. Pick the day(s) after registration and how many tuitions they must scroll that day first — the story then appears as the next card. A story shows at most once per day per rule.
Day 0 is the registration day, Day 1 is the next day the tutor opens the app, and so on. Days the tutor doesn't open the app are not counted.
